scripts.build: pnpm --filter @blockbase/contracts build && pnpm --filter @blockbase/core build && pnpm --filter @blockbase/mcp build && pnpm --filter @blockbase/preview build && pnpm --filter @blockbase/cli build
scripts.drift:check: pnpm --filter @blockbase/cli build && node integrations/agent/generate.mjs --check && node --test packages/core/test/projections.test.mjs packages/core/test/themes.test.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @blockbase/contracts test && pnpm --filter @blockbase/core test && pnpm --filter @blockbase/mcp test && pnpm --filter @blockbase/preview test && pnpm --filter @blockbase/cli test && pnpm run agent-portability && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @blockbase/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @blockbase/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @blockbase/mcp typecheck && pnpm --filter @blockbase/preview typecheck && pnpm --filter @blockbase/cli typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer.json --noEmit
